results.title: Anahat Singh goes down to world No 9 Tinne Gilis in Qatar Classic squash
results.description: Tinne Gilis, who has reached a career-high ranking of No 5, drew from her wealth of experience to win the match 11-4, 8-11, 9-11, 11-4, 11-3.

results.title: Rugby's Greatest Rivalry Reignited: All Blacks vs. Springboks
results.description: New Zealand and South Africa have successfully revived their historic rivalry by establishing a new franchise called Rugbys Greatest Rivalry The series which marked the All Blacks first full-scale tour of South Africa in 30 years ended with a thrilling match in Baltimore

results.title: Paddle Pulse Open: Arjun-Niranjan Beat Aadit-Tejas to Seal Intermediate Men’s Doubles Title
results.description: Arjun Kumar and Niranjan Gaikwad overcame their group-stage setback and defeated Aadit Palresha and Tejas Gaikwad in the final to clinch the Intermediate Men’s Doubles title at the Paddle Pulse Open in Pune.
